title: Logoisum Video Agency
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.check: Local Barlow and Instrument Serif fonts loaded
Workreel dialog plays supplied film with controls
Meeting draft validation, summary and downloadable request
Mobile 390x844, no horizontal overflow, full viewport hero
Mobile navigation opens, selects a panel and closes
Reduced motion pauses automatic background playback
No browser script errors or HTTP asset failures
Desktop and mobile screenshots visually reviewed

notes: Static build uses /motionsites-results/logoisum-video-agency/ as its base path. Not deployed or pushed.
Original supplied MP4 and requested fonts are stored locally; no overlays or page-image substitutes.
Custom SVG logo approximation because no logo artwork was supplied.
No separate reel or testimonials supplied: reel transparently previews the original landscape film; testimonial dialog shows a pending-content message.
No booking service supplied: meeting form creates and downloads a local draft only; no request is transmitted or meeting scheduled.
Browser check details: screenshots/checks.json. Chromium tested; Safari and physical devices not tested.
README.md contains project, build, verification, asset provenance and limitations.
